name: Yuvarti Craft
description:
Traditional Indian art and craft forms have lost the essence and flavour today in the midst of urbanisation.
Yuvarti craft aims at bringing these hidden art forms from rural India to urban India by working with the rural artisans specialised in the various art forms being is their family tradition handed down through generation’s.
Our area of specialisation is in varied fields like wall art, Terracotta, lippan kaam, Brass art, MOP, Wood, Glass art to name a few....to create eclectic interior spaces.
We design/customise as per the requirement of clients individually. We work with the artisans onsite to reproduce the art form in traditional or contemporary style as per the needs of our esteemed clients.
